title: What an Agent Behaviour Policy is
subtitle: Everything your agent can reach, what you asked it to do, the gap, and what stands in the way. 8 panels.
rule: Every line a character says is the storyboard's, not a quote. The vocabulary is riskmandate.ai's and abp.sgit.ai's: grant, mandate, delta, barrier; none, expectation, setting, boundary.

scenes.title: What your agent can do, and what you asked it to
scenes.subtitle: An Agent Behaviour Policy, in eight panels.
scenes.note: One agent, one deployment, one document. It describes; it does not judge.

scenes.caption: A small request, and a big capability

cast.says: Done. I could also read your .env and push to main.

scenes.note: The request is small. What the agent holds is not: the credential it runs with reaches much further.

scenes.caption: The grant: everything it can reach
scenes.note: One row per capability, in a fixed vocabulary of 23. Measured on the deployment where we are entitled to run it, documented from the vendor's pages where not.

scenes.caption: The mandate: what you asked for, in your words

cast.says: This is what I actually wanted.

scenes.note: The only part a person writes. The agent drafts it, the person corrects it, and the correction is almost always downward.

scenes.caption: The delta: what it can do that nobody asked for

cast.says: Nobody. I never thought of it.

scenes.note: Excess is what the grant allows and the mandate never asked for. Derived by the build, never typed.

scenes.caption: What stands in the way of each row

stops.label: expectation
stops.note: a rule in prose: the line

scenes.note: Four barriers, weakest first. Only the boundary is a control in the strict sense: enforced by something the grant does not include.

scenes.caption: A line it reads, and a hook that holds it
scenes.note: The line goes in CLAUDE.md. The hook goes in .claude/settings.json, and Claude Code runs it before the tool call, outside the model.

scenes.punchline: It describes. It does not judge.

cast.says: No score. Just what is true.

scenes.note: An Agent Behaviour Policy carries no score. The same one is harmless in one deployment and dangerous in another; the deployment changed, not the document.
